changes: Console front control/cover fit and rear close stacked USB pair
GamePad control positions, stick caps, camera/sensor strip and symmetrical speaker outlets
Correct top-port sides, separate top television IR window and bottom-facing charging contacts
Original rear SYNC control and empty stylus holder
Published adapter enclosures and stylus dimensions

validation.strict_scope: Listed changed housings, optical windows, caps, adapters and new markings; not a full baseline strict-BOP certification

limitations: No physical hardware scan or factory molding drawings were obtained.
Image-calibrated positions, cap/rim shapes, front-cover size, local wall thicknesses, port depth and optical-window geometry remain estimates.
The public adapter sizes are applied to the enclosure; cable/strain-relief projections are separate and the manufacturer's precise exclusion convention is not independently measured.
Button PCB outlines, case-post notches, fan/duct alignment, audio leads and the stylus guide are reconstructed internal accommodations, not factory PCB or airflow geometry.
Rear crossbar, shoulder surfaces, battery-cover proportions and fine molding transitions remain inherited approximations; the changed controls and ports do not constitute a scan-derived shell.
The rear SYNC cap is modeled; its unmeasured underlying switch package is not reproduced.
Photographs show an inserted stylus and open console front cover, while the study displays the stylus separately and normally closes that cover.
Reference images and manual pages remain local and are not redistributed.
